title: REDACT: PII/PHI Detection and Anonymization for Security Telemetry
description:
PII/PHI detection and anonymization for heterogeneous security telemetry. A three-layer detection ensemble (regex, Microsoft Presidio NER, Shannon entropy) sits behind a taxonomy-driven anonymization router (redaction, keyed pseudonymization, reversible tokenization) and a field-level drift detector.

Includes PCCF (Presence-Conditioned Conformal Fusion), a per-group conformal calibration method for multi-layer PII candidate fusion, mechanically validated across 11 research phases on synthetic and real documents (TAB, Broad Twitter Corpus, WNUT-17, GermEval, FactRuEval, ANERcorp, MEDDOCAN, and more). See PCCF_SUMMARY.md in the repository for the full hypothesis index.

No real personal data is included anywhere in this repository; all detection is validated against synthetic corpora (fixed random seed) or publicly licensed research benchmarks, each cited with its own license in the results documents.
